cases.name: Patricia Kay “Pat” McGlothlin Jeschke
cases.about:
Cathy Green (a former co-worker) was just 20 years-old when Jeschke was murdered in 1980 at the age of 31 but has fond memories of Jeschke. 

"I just want to make it clear how wonderful Pat was and how much she was of an influence on my life," Green said." I really appreciated knowing her and how devasted everybody at the library was when that happened."
cases.narrative: On 11/13/1980, her mother broke a window to enter her house and discovered Patricia's body, nude and with a laceration in the back of her head and a cord around her neck. She had been sexually assaulted.

cases.name: Jozlyn Marie Beechner
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Jozlyn was sweet, smart, sassy, ornery and happy all wrapped up in one little body with giant blue eyes. She loved to color and dance. She liked to laugh and tease with her friends and family. She loved pink and purple, rainbows, unicorns, glitter, and bows."
cases.narrative: On 9/2/2022, police found her body wrapped in a sheet on the roof of her home.
